create.name: Dr. Steven Farmer
create.bio:
Dr. Steven Farmer is a shamanic practitioner, author and ordained minister who lives in Ashland, Oregon. He trained first in psychology, earning three degrees and teaching at college level, and spent decades as a licensed psychotherapist before shamanism, ceremony and Earth-centred spirituality became the heart of his work. He is ordained in the Circle of Sacred Earth Church.

He is best known for his writing on animal spirit guides and the living Earth. His titles include Earth Magic, Animal Spirit Guides, Sacred Ceremony, Healing Ancestral Karma and a Pocket Guide to Spirit Animals, together with oracle decks such as Power Animal Oracle Cards, Earth Magic Oracle Cards and Messages from the Ancestors. Today he offers one-to-one spiritual mentoring, in person at his Ashland office or over Zoom, for people in a time of transition who want to clarify their life purpose, connect with their spirit guides and, if they feel called, begin a shamanic practice of their own. He also teaches self-paced online courses on the shaman's path and on working with animal guides, hosts a podcast, and leads free seasonal gatherings online, from gratitude in November to a Winter Solstice ceremony. Visitors to his site can draw free single or three-card oracle readings from three of his decks.

courses.title: 3-Month Spiritual Mentorship Program
courses.description: Six one-hour sessions over three months with Steven, in his Ashland office or over Zoom. The mentoring focuses on life purpose, working with spirit guides and, where it fits, starting a shamanic practice.
courses.price: $1,560 USD (or $570 USD a month for 3 months)

courses.title: 6-Month Spiritual Mentorship Program
courses.description: Twelve one-hour mentoring sessions spread over half a year, in person in Ashland or online. Suited to someone working through a longer transition who wants steady guidance on purpose and spiritual practice.
courses.price: $2,940 USD (or $535 USD a month for 6 months)

courses.title: 12-Month Spiritual Mentorship Program
courses.description: A year of one-to-one mentoring with twenty-four hour-long sessions, held in Ashland or by Zoom. The longest of his mentoring options, it leaves room to build a shamanic practice over time.
courses.price: $5,520 USD (or $490 USD a month for 12 months)

courses.title: The Path of the Shaman
courses.description: A self-paced online course on the shaman's role and practices. It covers journeying to the Lower World to meet power animals, working with spirit guides and ancestors, and creating ceremonies for everyday life.

courses.title: Animal Spirit Guides Online Course
courses.description: A six-week online course, run with DailyOM, with a written lesson and a guided audio meditation each week. It introduces animal spirit guides and how to recognise and call on them.

free_resources.title: Free Power Animal Oracle Reading
free_resources.description: Draw a single card or a three-card spread online from Steven's Power Animal deck, which pairs each card with an animal guide and its message.

free_resources.title: Free Animal Spirit Guides Oracle Reading
free_resources.description: An online reading from his Animal Spirit Guides cards: ask a question and draw one or three cards to see which animal has guidance for you.

free_resources.title: Free Earth Magic Oracle Reading
free_resources.description: A one-card or three-card online reading from the Earth Magic deck, with messages drawn from the elements and the natural world.
